s: Today we are talking about nature.
Nature is all around us: trees, rivers, the sun, and more.
The sun is in the sky every day.
The sun gives us light and warm days.
In summer the sun is hot.
I love to walk in the sun.
But too much sun can burn your skin!
We say the word a lot because we see it every day.
A tree is a big plant with leaves.
Trees give us shade from the sun.
I sat under a tree yesterday.
The tree was very old and tall.
Birds like to sit in trees too.
A bird is an animal with wings.
I saw a small bird in the park.
The bird was singing in the tree.
A river is water that moves.
A river runs through the land to the sea.
We sat by the river and watched the water.
A river can be long and wide.
People swim in the river in summer.
I want to visit that river again!
The sea is big water, bigger than a river.
The sea is blue and deep.
I love the sea in the morning.
We walked by the sea and heard the waves.
Many boats sail on the sea.
Fish and big animals live in the sea.
I want to swim in the sea this weekend.
A flower is the pretty part of a plant.
I picked a red flower for you.
One flower can make your day happy.
A flower needs sun and rain.
In spring the garden is full of flowers.
That yellow flower is my favorite.
Rain is water from the sky.
I like the sound of rain.
The rain helps the trees and flowers.
Do you like the rain, Lena?
After the rain, the air is fresh.
Yes, I really love the rain!
A cloud is white water in the sky.
I see shapes in every cloud.
That cloud looks like a bird!
White clouds mean a sunny day.
I love watching a cloud drift by.
A mountain is a very high hill.
The mountain is covered with snow.
We climbed a small mountain last year.
From the top of the mountain, you can see the sea!
The mountain air is so clean.
I want to see that mountain one day.
Grass is the green plant on the ground.
Fresh green grass after the rain smells wonderful!
I love walking on the grass with no shoes.
In the park the grass is so green.
Let's have a picnic on the grass!
So today we learned ten nature words: the sun, a tree, a bird, a river, the sea, a flower, the rain, a cloud, a mountain, and grass.
Let's say them again: sun, tree, bird, river, sea, flower, rain, cloud, mountain, grass.
Practice them today, and see you next time on Word Kitchen!
